_metadata.description: A valid .d sidecar paired with its (untampered) source .d, but the sidecar's payload.d_content_hash has had its last hex character flipped after signing. The recomputed hash from disk does not match the field; verifier reports HASH_MISMATCH on d_content_hash. (NOTE: this is one possible diagnosis; the same mutation also breaks the signature, so implementations MAY surface this as SIGNATURE_MISMATCH if they verify the signature before recomputing hashes. The v0 reference verifier checks hashes first.)
